exposure: cesarean delivery during the second stage of labor
Forceps vaginal delivery vs. cesarean delivery during the second stage of labor
outcome: Composite of perinatal mortality and/or hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE)
cohort: 7046 women carrying a singleton term nonanomalous fetus with vertex presentation who underwent forceps vaginal delivery or cesarean delivery from a low station in the second stage of labor.
finding: In women who required intervention during the second stage of labor with a station of +2 or below, forceps delivery was associated with a lower frequency of maternal infection but a higher rate of postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: In women who required intervention during the second stage of labor with a station of +2 or below, forceps delivery was associated with a lower frequency of maternal infection but a higher rate of postpartum hemorrhage.
